The one structural fact. The video has no audio track — it is ninety seconds of silent motion graphics, cut to sixty for this. You are not playing a video and then talking. You are talking the entire time, and the video is your slide deck advancing itself on a clock you cannot pause. Every scene ends on a 2–3.5 s hold; that hold is your slack.

The script

Accented rules are spoken. Dashed rules are deliberate silence — the screen is doing the work, and talking over a reveal destroys it. Toggle Español / English above, or press E. Word counts are budgeted at 2.5 w/s for English and 3.0 w/s for Spanish; Spanish runs 15–20% longer for the same content, so the two scripts are counted separately and the tight beats are marked.

Speaking Spanish over English visuals is fine and normal — but it changes one instruction. The on-screen thesis in S2 types at 44 characters/second, so it finishes in 2.5 s while saying it aloud takes about 8 s in either language. Do not race the typing. Start when it starts, finish long after it has stopped; the sentence sits on screen for the rest of the scene.

Decimales en español. La página imprime 0.853 con punto, pero en voz alta va con coma: “cero coma ocho cinco tres”. Decir “cero punto” también se entiende en la sala; lo que no puedes hacer es dudar a mitad del número. Elige uno en el ensayo y no lo cambies.
1:36 La deriva — este es el clímax 16s · slow down · el beat más apretado

ES · 47 palabras · 15,6s de 16s — sin margen Después nuestra propia librería de probes se desvió. Empezó a archivar checks reales como “no cuenta”, lo que achica el denominador y sube el puntaje.

La auditoría lo detectó antes de que llegara a un número publicado. Nuestro propio modo de falla, detectado por nuestra propia contra-métrica.

EN · 38 words Then our own probe library drifted. It started filing real checks as “doesn't count” — which shrinks the denominator and raises the score.

The audit caught it before it reached a published number. Our own failure mode, caught by our own counter-metric.

Why this beats “we came last”. Anyone can publish an unflattering number about themselves. Almost nobody can show the mechanism they built to catch themselves actually catching them — in the direction that would have flattered them. This is the hardest claim in the pitch and it is fully measured. If you land one thing, land this.

EN · 21 words AI-native maturity is not how much of your stack is automated. It is how much of it your agents cannot author.

Después para. Sin resumen, sin “gracias por su tiempo”. La sala se lleva una sola frase y es esta.

Then stop. No summary, no thank-you-for-your-time. The room remembers one sentence and this is the one.

Pre-flight

Six items. There is no terminal in this pitch, so most of the four-minute sheet's failure surface is simply gone.

  1. The video file plays. video/out/keel-pitch-60.mp4 — 60.05 s, 1920×1080, 30 fps. Open it once, full screen, on the machine that will present. Confirm it ends on the close lockup and does not loop.
  2. Player will not show chrome. QuickTime full-screen hides controls after a second; a browser tab does not. Use the player, not the tab.
  3. Tab 1 loaded and scrolled to top: https://broomva.github.io/keel/reports/. Verified 200 at time of writing. Confirm the pooled figure and the first table row are both visible without scrolling at projector resolution — if not, zoom out one step now.
  4. Tab 2, unopened backup: site/reports/index.html from the clone, openable from file://. This is the whole demo with the network down.
  5. Rehearse the one switch — player → browser — on the actual keys, at 1:11. It is the only mechanical risk left.
  6. Two timed dry runs with a stopwatch. One straight through; one where you deliberately overrun the cold open by five seconds, to feel where the cut list bites. (Not doable by an agent. Not done.)

Fallback ladder

Rung 1 is the pitch. Every rung below is still a complete pitch, one claim smaller. Never climb back up mid-run.

rungwhat brokewhat you dowhat you lose
1nothingvideo, then the live page—
2network gonevideo, then site/reports/index.html from the clone“this is live right now” — so do not say it
3video will not playthe corpus page alone, and talk the arc over the tablethe reel; the argument survives intact
4laptop or projector gonethe cold open, the thesis, and the three numbers from memorythe demo — not the argument
Rung 2 is one sentence away from a lie. The phrase “this is live right now” is only true on rung 1. Off-network the same page is a committed file, which is still real and still yours — say “this is the published corpus report” instead. In a pitch about ungrounded claims, an overclaim in the fallback is the one unrecoverable failure.

Numbers — all measured

Source: reports/corpus-summary.json, generated 2026-07-25. A number without its denominator is the move this product exists to expose.

figurevaluethe denominator it travels with
Pooled corpus grounding ratio0.853122 anchored / 143 classified edges, 14 repositories, 190 not_a_check excluded
Mean of per-repo ratios0.86714 targets with a denominator. Printed beside the pooled figure because the mean hides size and the pooled hides spread
Keel, in its own corpus0.3575 anchored of 14 classified · 25 judged of 32 gathered — 78% of the surface. Lowest in the corpus.
Keel, full-population dogfood0.4218 anchored of 19 classified · 32 gathered, 13 not_a_check. This is the number in the video
Corpus size15declared and pinned by 40-char sha; 14 measured, 1 gathered nothing and says so
Probe library growth0 → 29across the sequential run, from an empty library. R² 0.99
Estimated tokens per node−66.5%R² 0.28 — noisy, and the chart says so on its face rather than in a footnote
ε-audit disagreements2 of 13verdicts from the over-matching probe; blast radius checked, not assumed; neither reached a published report
Test suite153 passtsc --noEmit clean; CI green on ubuntu and macOS
Do not say the corpus proves most verification is ungrounded. Pooled 0.853 is a high number, and most of the corpus is mature hand-maintained OSS that scores at or near 1.0. What the table actually shows is spread — from 0.357 to 1.000 — and that the lowest scores cluster in the newest, most-generated repositories. That is an observation over 14 targets at a 25-node cap, not a law. State it that way or not at all.

Cut list

In order. Cut from the top the moment you are ten seconds down at the 1:11 switch.

  1. “Only the position changes.” (S2, ~2s)
  2. The not_a_check denominator rule. (S3, ~5s — keep “unknown fails closed”)
  3. “Flask, requests, commander, all above us.” (corpus, ~4s)
  4. The mean-of-targets figure, if you were going to add it. (never in the script; do not add it under time pressure)
  5. Compress the drift beat to its second sentence only. (~7s — last resort)
Never cut: the thesis sentence at 0:23, the count-up silence at S4, and the fact that the audit caught the drift before it reached a published number. Those three are the pitch; everything else is support.

The four questions you will actually get

Una respiración cada una. Di la línea acentuada y cállate. — One breath each. Say the accented line and stop talking.

“El video decía 0.421 y la página dice 0.357.” “The video said 0.421 and the page says 0.357.”

Los dos son nuestros y los dos están publicados. 0,421 es la corrida sobre la población completa, 8 de 19 aristas clasificadas; 0,357 es la corrida del corpus con el tope de 25 nodos, igual que todos los demás repos de esa página. Publicamos los dos en vez de elegir el que nos favorece — que es exactamente la conducta que este proyecto existe para detectar.

Both are ours and both are published. 0.421 is the full-population run over all 19 classified edges; 0.357 is the corpus run under a 25-node cap, same as every other repo on that page. We publish both rather than picking the flattering one — which is the entire behaviour this project exists to detect.

“¿No es subjetivo el clasificador?” “Isn't the classifier subjective?”

Cada veredicto trae un argumento causal falsable: qué produce esta señal, y si el actor puede escribirla. El argumento es la evidencia, y lo puedes verificar en segundos sin confiar en mí ni en el modelo.

Every verdict ships a falsifiable causal-path argument — what produces this signal, and can the actor write to it. The argument is the evidence, and you can check it in seconds without trusting me or the model.

“¿Un ratio alto significa que el repo está bien testeado?” “Does a high ratio mean the repo is well tested?”

No. Forma, no calidad — un repo puede estar 100% anclado con tests pésimos. El anclaje dice que la señal viene de afuera; no dice que la señal sea suficiente.

No. Shape, not quality — a repo can be 100% anchored with terrible tests. Anchoring says the signal comes from outside; it does not say the signal is sufficient.

“El mismo agente escribió el código y los tests — ¿qué prueba el verde?” “The same agent wrote the code and the tests — what does green prove?”

Que la ejecución está anclada y el oráculo puede no estarlo. El runtime decide honestamente si pasa o falla, pero las aserciones se escribieron dentro del límite de escritura, así que ambos pueden desviarse juntos y seguir en verde. Clasificamos el eje de ejecución y nombramos ese límite en vez de ascenderlo silenciosamente a prueba.

That the execution is anchored and the oracle may not be. The runtime honestly decides pass or fail, but the assertions were authored inside the write boundary, so both can drift together and stay green. We classify the execution axis and name that limit rather than silently upgrading it to proof.
